name: speedrun
description: speedrun.com is a speedrunning leaderboard site with games, categories, runs and runners. No commands could be generated because every request was blocked by Cloudflare.
notes: The only recorded request was GET https://www.speedrun.com/. It returned a 307 redirect to a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' page, and no JSON or content data was captured. Every page the explorer tried, including /games, showed the same challenge.

The site's robots.txt disallows the public REST API path (/api/v1/...). No API request appeared in the recording, so none was added. Adding unrecorded endpoints would mean guessing at their shapes, and robots.txt says automated clients should not use that path.

To build this CLI, the site owner would need to allow automated access, for example through an API key, a non-Cloudflare-challenged API host, or a robots.txt change permitting /api/v1. Exploration would then need to be re-run so real endpoints can be recorded.
Agents needing speedrun.com data should currently use a browser or another sanctioned data source; this CLI exposes no working commands.
